head: iCloud outage on 10 November: Mail, sign-in and Find My hit, now fixed
dek: Apple confirmed an outage on 10 November that stopped iCloud Mail and Apple Account sign-in for some users and slowed Find My. Apple said all services were working again the same evening.
details: It started around 2:49 p.m. Pacific time. Some people were signed out of their Apple Account. Apple's System Status page listed the affected services.
means: If iCloud acted up on Monday evening, it wasn't your device; it should work again now.
todo: If you were signed out, sign back in to your Apple Account; check apple.com/support/systemstatus next time something stops.
